hooks.name: Guard the two-app contract
hooks.description: Fires when the agent saves C# anywhere in the repo. Blocks edits to foundation-owned code that were made inside an app copy instead of the canonical foundation tree, because those edits are silently lost on the next sync.

hooks.name: Compile gate after C# save
hooks.description: Batch-compiles the affected Unity project in headless mode and fails loudly on any CS error. Catches the 'it looked fine in the diff' class of breakage before a human opens the editor.

hooks.name: Keep .kiro out of gitignore
hooks.description: Kiroween disqualifies submissions whose .kiro directory is gitignored. This re-checks every save of a .gitignore file and restores the exclusion if someone adds one.

hooks.name: Scene GUID integrity
hooks.description: A broken .meta means a scene silently loses a reference. Runs when a .meta file is saved and reports any duplicate or missing GUID that would corrupt a scene on import.

hooks.name: Remind: foundation changes need both apps
hooks.description: Agent prompt hook. When the agent is about to design a change, it reminds it that any foundation edit has to be propagated to both apps, which is the single most common way this repo breaks.

action.prompt: Before you write code: if the change touches foundation/Assets/DuckGame/{Runtime,Shaders,Art}, it must be synced into BOTH apps/training-range/unity and apps/expedition/unity. Run tools/sync-foundation.ps1 after the edit. If the change is content-only, put it in the app's own Assets/DuckGame/Maps or Generated folder and leave foundation alone.
